groups.operation: xmlXIncludeProcessNode processes the document URL in xmlXIncludeDoProcessRoot.
groups.condition: An injected allocation failure occurs while copying the document URL.
groups.capability: xmlXIncludeGetLastError(xinc) must expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure.
groups.consequence: The failure flag is set while xinc->errNo remains zero, so xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure aborts.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: its URL-copy failure condition differs from the reference-allocation condition of the other error-state candidate.

groups.operation: xmlXIncludeProcessNode expands xi:include and calls xmlXIncludeNewRef.
groups.condition: An injected allocation failure occurs at xmlXIncludeNewRef's xmlMalloc.
groups.capability: xmlXIncludeGetLastError must expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure.
groups.consequence: The failure flag is set while ctxt->errNo remains zero, so xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure aborts.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: its reference-allocation failure condition differs from the document-URL-copy condition.

groups.operation: Configure an xmlXIncludeCtxt with xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler before xmlXIncludeProcessNode.
groups.condition: The entry creates an XInclude context but never installs its context-specific structured error handler and callback data.
groups.capability: Deliver XInclude errors and forward the configured callback and data to included XML parsing and XPointer evaluation.
groups.consequence: The context-specific structured callback behavior is unreachable for every fuzz input.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same missing xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler configuration, its error-forwarding capability, and its reachability consequence.
